tools.name: read_file
tools.description: Read the complete contents of a file from the file system as text. Handles various text encodings and returns an error for paths outside the allowed directories.

path.description: Absolute or workspace-relative path of the file to read.

tools.name: write_file
tools.description: Create a new file or completely overwrite an existing file with new content. Use with caution as it will overwrite existing files without warning.

path.description: Path of the file to write.

content.description: Full text content to write to the file.
